no_regime_gate.label: COUNTERFACTUAL — regime gate removed (not a policy)

limitations: The reader is not run; every ticket here is one the reader could still have refused.
The universe is the archive's later membership; names that left the market are absent (survivorship), so the regime's decliners and the candidates are both under-counted.
The bars are a later retrieval, not the original information set, and partial names stay partial.
Fills, exits and R are the daily-bar model of the published scorecard: a fill only at the next open inside the ticket, uncertain days scored nowhere, no fee, spread or slippage.
The counterfactual block removes the regime gate to show what it refused; it is not a policy.
Counts are not an edge claim; the public scorecard reads no rate under its own minimum.
